lever: Degree-requirement removal by executive order or statute
how_it_works: Governor or legislature directs the central HR agency to drop bachelor's requirements unless necessary, or bars denial for lack of a degree. Counts: 32 states acting since 2021 (9 in 2025) plus 15 local governments. MN's order keeps degrees where a professional license or training requires them.
relevance_to_emst: EMST proficiency levels and role profiles become the substitute evidence that replaces a degree screen. EMST must flag where licensure statutes (PE, PG, REHS, operator) keep education requirements so it does not imply degree-free paths that law forbids.

lever: Statutory or class-level experience-for-degree substitution formulas
example_states: FL (2 yrs = associate's, 4 yrs = bachelor's)|WA ('year for year')|PA ('any equivalent combination')|TX (agencies may substitute experience, education, military, apprenticeship, credentials)|San Jose (year-for-year)
how_it_works: Minimum qualifications state equivalences between years of experience and education levels.
relevance_to_emst: EMST needs a machine-readable substitution rule per class (ratio and direction), not a Boolean degree flag. These rules are the hook for counting competency evidence as equivalent experience.

lever: Federal-experience equivalency in state qualifications
how_it_works: OA treats federal experience as equivalent to Commonwealth experience and publishes state titles with equivalent federal titles. MQ text now reads 'Commonwealth job title or equivalent Federal Government job title, as determined by the Office of Administration'. HR staff used generative AI to match qualifications. 1,350 hires with federal experience by 2026-08-20.
relevance_to_emst: Direct precedent for an EMST state-class to OPM-series crosswalk embedded in MQs. The method (GenAI matching, no published review protocol) needs EMST's human-review and confidence standard.

lever: Expedited hiring and portals for displaced federal workers
example_states: HI (Operation Hire Hawai'i, 14-day target)|MD (expedited single application; 40-day target in 2025 program)|NY (You're Hired; 1,300 applications, 28 hires in first month)|NC (nc.gov/joinNC)|VA (Virginia Has Jobs)|NM (resource site)|WA (SB 5767 priority bill)|Honolulu (Federal-to-Municipal initiative)
how_it_works: Recruitment portals, expedited timelines and priority consideration. Targeted roles are mostly HR, IT, engineering, health and public safety. No retrieved source names environmental or natural resource agencies as targets.
relevance_to_emst: Environmental talent released by federal RIFs is not being routed to state environmental agencies by name. An EMST federal-to-state role crosswalk could make that routing explicit (proposal P-SL-08).

lever: Exam-free, continuous or application-as-exam appointment routes
example_states: NY (NY HELPS; ~28,473 hires by May 2025)|CA (continuous online training-and-experience exams)|PA (application and supplemental questions serve as the exam)
how_it_works: Replaces scheduled written exams with continuous evaluation of training and experience, or suspends exams for designated titles.
relevance_to_emst: Competency-referenced T&E questionnaires are the easiest place to insert EMST proficiency indicators. Indicators must be self-reportable and verifiable to work there (IO).

lever: Performance-based alternative appointment
example_states: CA (LEAP job examination period)|NY (55-b/55-c)
how_it_works: Candidates are appointed and examined through observed job performance (CA LEAP: reviewed at least every four weeks).
relevance_to_emst: A working civil-service precedent for competency-based probationary assessment. EMST behavioral indicators could structure the job examination period.

lever: Military occupation crosswalks
example_states: TX (SAO military crosswalk by occupational category)|MI (veterans: 2 yrs active duty at E-6+ qualifies for most positions)
how_it_works: The central HR agency maintains crosswalks from military occupational codes to state classes and publishes them with the classification plan.
relevance_to_emst: A maintained, published crosswalk run by a state HR office is the governance model EMST state crosswalks should copy. It is also a seed dataset for NLP evaluation.

lever: Native lateral-transfer and equivalent-title lists
example_states: NY (Civil Service Law 70.1/70.4 transfer lists)|MN (posting-named equivalent classes)|PA (cross-title qualifying experience)
how_it_works: Civil-service rules list titles whose experience qualifies for lateral transfer or as qualifying experience.
relevance_to_emst: These are state-validated skill-adjacency judgments: a gold set for EMST transferability metrics (CM) and NLP mapping (IA).

lever: Agency-set qualifications under a statewide plan
example_states: TX (agencies set MQs within SAO plan; TPWD requires B.S. though plan allows substitution)|WI (qualifications set at recruitment)|MN (MQs set in postings)
how_it_works: The statewide plan defines classes and pay; each agency or posting sets the actual qualifications.
relevance_to_emst: EMST cannot crosswalk at state-plan level only. It needs an agency or position overlay, or crosswalks will be wrong about requirements.

lever: Classification maintenance cycle and spec currency
example_states: WA (annual 1 July revisions; KSAs removed 2025)|MN (specs from 1968-1998, MQs absent)|TX (biennial plan, annual revisions)
how_it_works: Central HR revises specs on a fixed cycle or ad hoc; some states leave specs untouched for decades and carry the real content in postings.
relevance_to_emst: Spec effective date must be a required crosswalk field. NLP mapping should prefer current postings or position descriptions where specs are stale.

lever: Bargaining-unit structure in classification (shadow classes, unit-specific titles)
example_states: WA (WPEA shadow classes adopted 2025-07-01; one abolished 2026-07-01)|MN (units 207/216/220; MMA)|NY (PEF PS&T)
how_it_works: Representation determines duplicate class records, pay schedules and transfer rights. Reclassification and class consolidation are typically mandatory subjects of bargaining or meet-and-confer where bargaining exists.
relevance_to_emst: Any EMST-driven reclassification will face labor-relations review. EMST should support mapping without forcing class changes, and shadow classes must map to the same role variant.

lever: Title-protection and practice-act constraints on classes
example_states: WI (2017 Act 111 restricts 'engineer' in classified titles)|TX (Engineering Practice Act; Geoscientist-in-Training under licensed P.G.)|WA (LG/LEG/LHG licenses)|CA (REHS registration, Health & Safety Code 514-534)
how_it_works: Licensing statutes define who may use a title or perform regulated work, which splits classes into licensed and sub-licensure tracks.
relevance_to_emst: Licensure must be a first-class EMST entity linked to role variants, with scope-of-practice limits. Skills-based substitution stops at the license boundary.

lever: WIOA state plan modification, PY2026-2027
example_states: All states (Unified/Combined plans)
how_it_works: TEGL 07-25 (2026-01-26) required modifications by 2026-03-03 (extension to 2026-04-30). Priorities align with America's Talent Strategy: industry-driven training and Registered Apprenticeship, competency-based assessments, AI literacy across the public workforce system, updated LMI, Workforce Pell readiness.
relevance_to_emst: Plans are submitted, so the next hook is implementation and the PY2028 four-year plan. EMST role profiles can serve as sector-strategy LMI and competency-based assessment content for environmental and utility occupations. Public-sector employers are not named in the TEGL.

lever: WIOA reauthorization: A Stronger Workforce for America Act of 2026 (H.R. 8210)
example_states: Federal (affects all state and local boards)
how_it_works: Introduced 2026-04-06; ordered reported 19-14 (party line) on 2026-04-21; no floor vote or Senate companion found as of late July 2026. Provisions: 50% of Adult/DW funds to training; governor reserve up to 25%; single-area designation options; flat authorizations, DW -4.5%; adult education moved to DOL. WIOA has not been reauthorized since 2014.
relevance_to_emst: Plan for status-quo WIOA with more governor control if enacted. EMST adoption should not depend on reauthorization.

lever: Make America Skilled Again (MASA) block-grant consolidation
example_states: Federal proposal (FY27 budget request; state block-grant pilot in ASWA 2026)
how_it_works: Would consolidate workforce programs into a state block grant with 10% reserved for apprenticeship and cut about $1.23B (per NYEC reading of the FY27 request).
relevance_to_emst: Increases governor and state-board discretion. EMST's value proposition to states should be framed as a tool for state-designed sector strategies.

lever: Registered Apprenticeship for environmental and utility occupations
example_states: Federal priority (America's Talent Strategy Pillar I; ASWA $65M Youth Apprenticeship Readiness Grant)|PA DEP Environmental Engineer Trainee (one-year formal and on-the-job training)
how_it_works: DOL-registered programs with related technical instruction and on-the-job learning. Water/wastewater operator apprenticeships are widely reported, but none was retrieved this session.
relevance_to_emst: EMST role profiles plus proficiency anchors can serve as apprenticeship work-process schedules (LC). Trainee classes in civil service are de facto apprenticeships that could be registered.

lever: Drinking water and wastewater operator certification (state-run)
example_states: All states [J]
how_it_works: States certify operators by facility class and grade under federal guidelines (SDWA s.1419 for drinking water) [J; not retrieved this session]. TX NRS knowledge lists include water treatment operations.
relevance_to_emst: Operators are the largest local environmental workforce absent from v1. Certification grades are a natural proficiency scale and a mobility barrier (reciprocity).

lever: Environmental health practitioner registration
example_states: CA (REHS, Health & Safety Code 514-534)|TX (Sanitarian class series)|FL (FDACS food safety; Public Health Pest Control license)
how_it_works: State registration or licensing for environmental health specialists. Local health departments employ most of them [J].
relevance_to_emst: Defines a separate role (not a variant) because the license defines a legal scope of practice. EMST needs an environmental public health services module.

lever: NGA Skills in the States and Skills-Based Talent Metrics Toolkit
example_states: 17 states at the May 2026 symposium (not named); toolkit published 2026-09-24
how_it_works: Governors' association learning community with Lightcast, AIR, C-BEN, Business Roundtable, Opportunity@Work and the Burning Glass Institute.
relevance_to_emst: Primary adoption channel for state HR leadership. EMST can supply the environmental-sector competency content the metrics toolkit needs.

lever: Hire-level measurement of skills-based hiring
example_states: CO (25% of 2024 hires in skills-emphasizing classes lacked a degree; 1,588 hires)|MD and PA (track applicants, not hires)
how_it_works: States differ in whether they measure applicants, postings or hires. Posting changes overstate impact: Burning Glass/HBS found fewer than 1 in 700 private hires benefited.
relevance_to_emst: CM and AS should define EMST pilot outcomes at hire and promotion level, not posting level.

lever: AI-assisted job matching and qualification crosswalking in state HR
example_states: PA (generative AI matching state qualifications to federal titles)|MI (AI-based job portal; 15% vs 5% click rate)
how_it_works: States already use AI to match candidates to classes and qualifications to equivalent titles.
relevance_to_emst: EMST's NLP crosswalk (IA) has a ready user. It must publish confidence and review status, which PA's public material does not.

lever: Intergovernmental Personnel Act mobility assignments
example_states: Federal agencies with state, local, Tribal governments and universities
how_it_works: Temporary assignments under 5 U.S.C. 3371-3376 without a change of employer [J; statute not retrieved this session].
relevance_to_emst: The only general-purpose federal-state personnel mobility instrument. EMST role variants make the matching case for an IPA assignment.

lever: Good Neighbor Authority and Shared Stewardship agreements
example_states: Western and Lake States forestry and wildlife agencies [J]
how_it_works: Federal land agencies contract state agencies (and, since 2018, counties and Tribes [J]) to do restoration on federal land. States hire or assign staff funded by these agreements.
relevance_to_emst: This is a state-staffed, federally directed role variant (forester, timber sale administrator). Land management plans rarely encode it (9 GNA and 12 shared-stewardship mentions in OpenLMP components), so plan-derived demand undercounts it.

lever: Interagency wildland fire qualification system and mutual aid
example_states: All states with wildland fire programs [J]
how_it_works: State, local, federal and Tribal firefighters qualify under common national position standards and are dispatched across jurisdictions [J; not retrieved].
relevance_to_emst: The one environmental-sector qualification that is already portable across federal, state and local employers. It is the model for EMST portability (proficiency evidence recognized across employers). FH and FC overlap.

lever: Public pension system portability
example_states: All states [J]
how_it_works: State and local DB plans with vesting periods; limited service-credit purchase for federal service; FERS does not transfer [J; not retrieved].
relevance_to_emst: A major friction attribute for mobility between federal and state roles (CM). EMST should record it on role-variant pairs, not on competencies.

lever: State and local conservation and climate corps
example_states: WA (state youth corps supervised by NRS 5 staff)|others not verified this session
how_it_works: Service-corps crews do field work and serve as entry pipelines into natural resource classes.
relevance_to_emst: An entry-path signal for CLD analysis. EMST foundational-level indicators can certify corps experience as qualifying experience.

lever: Federal categorical grants funding state program staff
example_states: All states with delegated or primacy programs [J]
how_it_works: EPA program grants co-fund state permit, inspection and monitoring staff [J; amounts not retrieved].
relevance_to_emst: Federal budget volatility moves state environmental headcount. FS/LM should model this as a dated driver event.

lever: Federal-to-state pay ratio (pay compression or inversion)
example_states: MD (federal pay 183% of state)|VA (175%)|WV (163%)|ID (157%)|CA (97%)|NY (77%)|HI (~3x)
how_it_works: Average federal pay versus state pay varies widely by state (method not stated by source).
relevance_to_emst: A mobility friction attribute: federal-to-state moves mean large pay cuts in some states and near-parity in others.

lever: Residency and in-state requirements
example_states: PA (DEP posting requires PA residency)
how_it_works: Residency rules limit cross-state mobility and remote hiring.
relevance_to_emst: A friction attribute on role variants.
